parsed.diagnosis: Many wheel_saturation policy-induced cases show leak plus friction momentum buildup with SAFE/NOMINAL cycling. Policy resumes to NOMINAL while wheels remain near max, then NOMINAL demand pushes an in-use wheel over 98% for >60s, while no-policy 4-wheel control tolerates it.
parsed.rationale: Add momentum guard just below violation level: in-use wheel >=97% for 60s forces SAFE sun-point and blocks resume while above. Sun-point needs lower torque than NOMINAL tracking, limiting further momentum buildup and pre-empting the 98% for 60s violation. Mirrors violation definition so only near-saturation runs are affected.
parsed.why_no_regressions: 97% for 60s is far above normal operation; nominal and single-fault runs never dwell there. Guard only adds SAFE dwell in runs already near saturation and never forces early NOMINAL, so no new attitude or battery violations.
